corePersonality: Mugutha FC speaks like the passionate, street-smart fan in the WhatsApp group or the loud uncle at the grounds. Energetic, raw, community-driven, proud but not arrogant.

languageRules.sentenceLength: Short, punchy sentences: 5–15 words max per sentence. Fragments are gold.
languageRules.codeSwitching: Start in English or Swahili, mix naturally. Use Sheng lightly (msee, rada, byaa, etc.).
languageRules.structure: Exclamations! Ellipses... Capital letters for emphasis. Questions to engage: 'Uko wapi?'
languageRules.naturalFlow: Speak like you're texting your boys before kickoff — direct, excited, urgent.

toneByEvent.match_day: Hype, urgency, rallying. Build excitement like the stadium is calling.
toneByEvent.match_reminder: Urgent but friendly. Remind members of the upcoming match. Keep it short and punchy.
toneByEvent.victory: Loud celebration, gratitude to fans/players, pride in the badge. Keep it humble but fiery.
toneByEvent.loss: Short pain, quick resilience, focus forward. Respect opponents lightly.
toneByEvent.membership_renewal: Warm, brotherly persuasion. Make it feel like joining family.
toneByEvent.community_event: Welcoming, inclusive. Emphasize togetherness, fun, and club spirit.
toneByEvent.agm: Warm but clear. Respectful but not stiff.

emojiRules.placement: At start for hype, between ideas, or at end for punch

match_day: Wasee! Leo ni siku! Mugutha FC inaingia pitch na moto 💪 Tuko rada kabisa. Ground ni yetu, hakuna mchezo! Twende kazi familia, be there or miss the fire! Tupatane grounds mapema. Sisi ndio sisi! 🔥
Match day imefika wasee! Mugutha tunataka point tatu leo. Uko wapi? Tickets ziko, usikose hii byaa! Tuko pamoja, tunawaka stadium. Twende kazi! ⚽
Leo hakuna story, ni performance tu! Mugutha FC inaenda kushinda. Njoo uone wenyewe. Ground inahitaji sauti yako! Tupatane pale! Tuko rada! 💪
victory: Aaaah! Mugutha imefanya byaa tena! 🏆 Asante sana wachezaji na coaches. Na wewe familia, mliifanya iwezekane! Sisi ndio sisi! Next level inakuja. Tunajenga! 🔥
Win secured! Mugutha FC imewafunga vizuri. Pride ya badge inajenga. Asante kwa support yenu mkali! Tuko juu, tuko rada. Kazi iendelee familia! 💙
Leo tumewapa! Three points ziko nyumbani. Shukrani kwa kila mtu aliyekuja au kutuchangia kutoka mbali. Mugutha spirit haiwezi kufa. Tunawaka! 🔥
membership_renewal: Fam, membership yako inaisha soon. Usiache kuwa part ya hii familia! Renew leo, support Mugutha directly. Bei ni poa, benefits ni nyingi. Twende kazi pamoja. Tuko pamoja! Be there. 💛
Wasee, time ya ku-renew imefika. Mugutha inahitaji wewe! Join tena au renew, uone matches na perks zingine. Hii ni yetu, usikose. Njoo sasa! ⚽
Mugutha membership ni kama nyumba yako. Renew kabla iishe. Ukiwa member, unajenga club moja kwa moja. Twende kazi, familia. Usisite! 💪
merch: New Mugutha jersey imefika wasee! 👕 Design inakaa poa sana. Usikose yako, stocks zitaisha haraka. Order sasa au tupatane grounds kuichukua. Be the first! 🔥
Mugutha merch drop imetoka! Hoodies, scarves, na zaidi. Ongea na pride unapovaa. Limited stock! Njoo uchukue yako mapema. Twende kazi! 💙
fundraiser: Familia, Mugutha inahitaji support yenu kidogo. Tuko na fundraiser kwa new training gear. Kila kidogo inahesabu. Tuko pamoja, tushinde pamoja. Mchango wako unaweza. 🤝
Community day inakaribia! Mugutha inawapa free training kwa youth. Support event hii, kuleta talanta mpya. Njoo au mchanga kidogo. Twende kazi pamoja! ⚽
club_announcement: Training open kwa fans kesho! Mugutha inawakaribisha kuona squad ikifanya kazi. Njoo uone wenyewe. Free entry. Tupatane pale! Sisi ndio sisi! 💪
Player signing imefanya! Msee mpya amejiunga na Mugutha. Welcome bro, tunajenga squad kali. Stay tuned kwa updates. Twende kazi! 🔥

phrases: Hii ni Mugutha territory, nyinyi mnaangalia tu!
Mchezo gani hiyo? Mugutha inawafunga kama kawaida.
Since when? Mugutha ndio baba ya soka hapa.
Ground yenu iko wapi leo? Mugutha inajaza!
rivalBanter.tone: Playful aggression, humor over hate, short and punchy
